integrity: The proof treats Fu's polynomial limit and multiple-root lemma as prior results. No authorship, independent external certification, or publication status is asserted.
scientific_limitations: All-degree result is for the finite vertex polynomial and the local near-vertex root consequences away from the collision. Neither an unrestricted Bergman kernel zero count nor the critical perturbation splitting is proved; general-degree collision parameters are given by a unique variational maximizer. An older equivalent truncated-series theorem is a residual priority risk.
title: Parity-controlled real zeros of generalized Hartogs vertex polynomials
